title: Chapter 1580 - 654: Yang Fish
content:
Chapter 1580: Chapter 654: Yang Fish

When Ning Zhuo stated that he had no hope of winning and was keen on preserving his life, Chun Yangzi’s fists tightened, genuinely wanting to give the big-headed youth a good beating to vent his frustration.

"It’s not bad that you have such self-awareness," Chun Yangzi spoke, his tone was harsh.

"But with Nanming Village making an all-out effort to rise, stirring up the wind and clouds, the momentum is vast. During the Five Battles Martial Arts, we are exhausting our efforts; one of our own has even died."

"In such circumstances, if we lose the fifth battle, all previous efforts will be in vain."

"As the military art says: ’Raise the spirit with one drum, weaken with two, exhaust with three!’"

"In contrast, the opponent’s morale must be soaring, and the next time they block our charge, they will certainly be even more united and willing to invest."

"So, never be careless and don’t assume there are many opportunities. Will we still have a good chance like this in the future?"

"Ning Zhuo, you are a clever person, use your brains and think carefully!"

"Nanming Village is united by interests and extremely loose. If there’s a major defeat, the will of the people will scatter, and thereafter Nanming Village will inevitably exist only in name. So, the first time may very well be our last chance!"

Chun Yangzi’s words were righteous and powerful.

Ning Zhuo showed a look of guilt: "Senior Chun Yangzi, you are absolutely right. But I am young, my cultivation level is merely Foundation Establishment Mid-Stage."

"Even if there is some support, I’m completely unfamiliar with it in a short period. I truly want to defeat the Three Brave of Xiang Sect, but in these circumstances, I have no confidence."

Bam.

Chun Yangzi slapped the table, slightly alleviating his anger.

He knew Ning Zhuo was asking him for benefits, understood that Ning Zhuo must have been waiting for him all along, yet he had no choice but to comply.

Even, he had to cooperate with Ning Zhuo to perform well in this act.

"This boy is really full of cunning tricks!"

Chun Yangzi gritted his teeth: "Alright, you have the will to defeat the Three Brave of Xiang Sect, that’s good. It’s not in vain that I’ve come here this time."

"Since I am the Great Village Chief of Nanming Village, how can I sit idly by while you face strong enemies alone?"

"Although the Red Robe Guest is my enemy, for dying for my village, my heart is moved, let past grievances scatter with the wind."

"This time, I will fully assist you to achieve victory!"

Ning Zhuo’s face was filled with joy: "Really? Senior Chun Yangzi, I knew you are a model of the Righteous Path, high-minded beyond ordinary reach!"

"But, do you truly have a way to drastically boost my combat power to confront the Three Brave of Xiang Sect?"

Ning Zhuo timely revealed a hint of doubt.

Chun Yangzi quietly watched Ning Zhuo’s performance, the fire in his eyes sank to the deepest depths, like lava congealed underground, hiding a mountain-burning power beneath the calm.

He snorted coldly: "I pondered long and hard to think of a wonderful strategy for you."

"But before that, I have an important question to ask you."

"Ning Zhuo, do you still have a Child Body?"

"Ah?!" This question was so abrupt that Ning Zhuo froze for a moment.

Ning Zhuo wanted to answer but hesitated again.

In terms of flesh body, he was naturally clean and unstained. However, having gone through many bizarre events since cultivation, with various entanglements involving him, he was unsure whether the Child Body referred to by the Pure Yang Palace pertained to the flesh body, Origin Yang, or something else.

Chun Yangzi was already impatient.

He reached out a hand, his five fingers clamping down on Ning Zhuo’s wrist like iron pincers, speaking in a deep voice: "Do not resist, if you wish to defeat the Three Brave of Xiang Sect rather than be killed by them, let me measure."

Ning Zhuo’s expression changed, immediately wanting to activate mana to protect himself, expelling Chun Yangzi’s mana and divine sense.

Such rash probing into another’s cultivation status was a major taboo; even against a Nascent Soul Cultivator like Chun Yangzi, Ning Zhuo would turn hostile.

However, Chun Yangzi did not use mana or divine sense, instead activating a unique technique, seemingly only targeting Ning Zhuo’s Child Body status for detection.

Just as Ning Zhuo was about to stop him, Chun Yangzi finished.

"??!!!" Chun Yangzi’s eyebrows suddenly shot up, the peaks drawn high by invisible strings, his expression became exaggerated.

"Your Yang Energy... is so abundant!" He still held Ning Zhuo’s wrist, the gesture like he’d seized a glowing, rare treasure, his fingertips slightly warm.

"Child Body. The purest Child Body!" His gaze towards Ning Zhuo turned completely different, the scripture characters on the red gold daoist robe began to swim, moving faster and revealing his suddenly surging mood.

"Ah!" Ning Zhuo froze again.

Chun Yangzi looked up and down at Ning Zhuo, his eyes full of surprise, envy, regret, and a desire that he could not suppress: "Ning Zhuo, would you be willing to switch to our sect’s ’Pure Yang Pill Scripture’?"

At this moment, his tone softened, and his perspective of Ning Zhuo changed.

Ning Zhuo showed a strange expression, gently withdrawing his wrist from Chun Yangzi’s grasp, rubbing the reddened area.

"Senior, there is no longer an independent mountain sect of the Pure Yang Palace in the world, only the Pure Yang Peak of the Myriad Images Sect exists."

"Besides, I hail from a Righteous Clan, bearing the responsibility of propagating descendants. Should I adhere to the Child Pure Yang for life to cultivate ’Pure Yang Pill Scripture,’ it may violate filial piety."

Chun Yangzi’s passionate expression froze, instinctively picking up a cup, trying to mask it by drinking tea, but the tea’s aroma was quite ordinary!

Chun Yangzi picked up the teacup then set it down, the bottom hitting the table with a soft sound: "I... was out of line."

Though he said so, the fire in his eyes watching Ning Zhuo remained lingering.

He sighed: "I have seen many people, but never such a dense and pure Pure Yang Qi as yours. If you cultivate ’Pure Yang Pill Scripture,’ your future achievements will certainly surpass mine, perhaps even rivaling the founder of the sect."
